reason: I would take the free trial, but I would not pay yet. I only need contacts and deals, and a CRM nobody has vouched for makes me nervous with my client data. I will keep my spreadsheets and Telegram until someone I know uses it.
objection: No references at all. If I move all my clients in and it disappears or breaks, I lose my sales history. The plans also jump from 25 to 49 to 199, and I only want contacts and deals, not finance and inventory.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three Uzbek companies like mine that I can call and who use it, plus a 49 dollar plan that is honestly enough for my sales team.
